title: Trying to pick a Google Play icon. Started with a screenshot. Before -> After
author: Maximum_Ad7255
selftext:
I’m working on the Google Play icon for my game. On the left is the original in-game screenshot. On the right, I sketched a little face on the cannonball and used ImageGen to refine the icon.

I wanted it to feel like the ship just fired straight at you. Does that come across at phone size?

comments.author: DrElectro
comments.body: Awesome! Great composition, you should publish it now!

comments.author: kavokonkav
comments.body: Remove the face off the canon ball maybe

replies.author: Maximum_Ad7255
replies.body: Thank you! May be I have to remove the face and add a fired fuze. To make the cannonball more recognizable

replies.author: Fun-Sundae4060
replies.body: I think removing the face would be a mistake

comments.author: kytheon
comments.body: Right one has more color. The face on the cannon ball is too much and not enough at the same time.

replies.author: Maximum_Ad7255
replies.body: Thank you! It is really the face is controversial thing!

comments.author: golfstreamer
comments.body: I really like how you designed the right icon. It feels like something that really sticks in your head.  Is the canon ball the game's logo?

replies.author: Maximum_Ad7255
replies.body: No, the canon ball isn't the game logo yet. But I tried to add it to catch the eye of players.

comments.author: Initial_Plastic_8069
comments.body: tehre was a conceptual difference, but the 1st image is still \`better\` if you could mix the 2 somehow imo, bcs I wouldnt click number 2 myself
